challenge.name: The Loyalty Data Audit
challenge.description: A legal audit flagged that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, breaking the legal basis for using it in forecasts. #requirements_reuben# demands the data contracts be fully automated and governed to enforce consent checks before any data enters the pipeline. #efficiency_emilia# argues that manual review is sufficient for now to avoid delaying the promotion planning cycle, though she might accept a middle ground if it does not stall the weekly leaflet.

output.content: I can live with the risk assessment staying manual for now. My only condition is that the main pipeline remains stable. If the deployment tooling holds up and we do not see any drift in the data contracts, I will not push for full automation on that specific check. I am happy to trade the strictness of the governance layer for the speed of the release cycle. As long as the integration points are reliable, I will accept the manual review step without complaint.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to give up the strictness of the governance layer (manual risk assessment) in exchange for the speed of the release cycle, provided the pipeline remains stable.
